name: Signal Desk Saved Views

provenance.label: SYNTHETIC / DEMO-ONLY
provenance.description: Authentication-independent design context authored locally for the Copilot-for-Product demo. It is not exported from Figma and contains no external design URL.

viewportFrames.purpose: Full feedback queue with persistent filter toolbar and view picker
Wrapped toolbar with active view state kept adjacent to actions
Apply, inspect, and recover through a full-screen picker

components.nativeStartingPoint: button plus dialog/listbox pattern selected after accessibility review

rules: Do not rely on color alone
Keep view name visible when filters wrap

contentSamples.localOnlyNote: Saved in this browser only. Clearing site data removes this view.
contentSamples.zeroResults: No feedback matches this view. Review its filters or choose another view.
contentSamples.storageError: Views cannot be saved in this browser right now. You can continue filtering feedback.

interactionNotes: Applying a view replaces supported filters after validation.
Current permissions are evaluated each time; stored state never grants access.
Filter edits never overwrite a view without an explicit action.
Escape dismisses transient surfaces without saving and restores focus.
Reduced-motion users receive equivalent state changes without animation.
handoffChecks: Keyboard-only create, apply, rename, delete, and recovery
Reflow at 320 CSS px and 400 percent zoom
Corrupt local data and unavailable storage
No telemetry payload contains names, values, or feedback content
